# Per-series statistical tests (test window w26) (generated by code/stat_tests.py)

Friedman test over 7 methods on complete cases; Nemenyi critical difference CD at α = 0.05; Wilcoxon signed-rank vs lgb_quantile, Holm-adjusted. 'ref better' = share of series where lgb_quantile is strictly better.
Fill rate and inventory: default scenario (τ = 0.9, L = 2), no liquidation, series with demand in the KPI weeks.
